repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 1-minute (60,000 ms) sustained wait. The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 60 ticks. This results in a 60-second wait (60 * 1000 ms), which is 10 seconds too long. The mismatch at 59000 ms confirms the action fired early relative to the 60-second mark, but the IR expects the action to fire exactly at 60,000 ms. The fix requires changing the wrapper period to 100 ms and adjusting the threshold to 601 ticks (600 ticks for the duration + 1 for the initial state).
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period from 1000 ms to 100 ms to match the fine-grained timing required for a 1-minute sustain. Updated the threshold from 60 to 601 to correctly count 60 full 100 ms intervals plus the initial tick, ensuring the action fires exactly at 60,000 ms.
